package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const SubjectPlanningStateChanged = "student.planning-state.changed.v1"
const MaximumPlanningStateEventBytes = 256 << 10

type PlanningStateChangedEvent struct {
	EventID       string                   `json:"event_id"`
	EventType     string                   `json:"event_type"`
	CorrelationID string                   `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID   string                   `json:"causation_id"`
	StudentID     string                   `json:"student_id"`
	OccurredAt    time.Time                `json:"occurred_at"`
	SchemaVersion int                      `json:"schema_version"`
	Data          PlanningStateChangedData `json:"data"`
}
type PlanningStateChangedData struct {
	LearningPathID  string            `json:"learning_path_id"`
	PathVersion     int64             `json:"path_version"`
	TriggerKind     string            `json:"trigger_kind"`
	TriggerIdentity string            `json:"trigger_identity"`
	Targets         []HybridTargetRef `json:"targets"`
}

func PlanningStateChangedEventID(studentID, pathID, kind, identity string) string {
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte(SubjectPlanningStateChanged+":"+studentID+":"+pathID+":"+kind+":"+identity)).String()
}
func ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(e PlanningStateChangedEvent) error {
	d := e.Data
	if e.EventType != SubjectPlanningStateChanged || e.SchemaVersion != 1 || !canonicalUUID(e.StudentID) || e.StudentID == uuid.Nil.String() || !canonicalUUID(d.LearningPathID) || d.LearningPathID == uuid.Nil.String() || !canonicalUUID(d.TriggerIdentity) || d.TriggerIdentity == uuid.Nil.String() || e.EventID != PlanningStateChangedEventID(e.StudentID, d.LearningPathID, d.TriggerKind, d.TriggerIdentity) || e.CorrelationID != d.LearningPathID || e.CausationID != d.TriggerIdentity || d.PathVersion < 1 || (d.TriggerKind != "OBJECTIVE_EVIDENCE" && d.TriggerKind != "LEARNING_INTENT") || !canonicalUTCMicro(e.OccurredAt) || len(d.Targets) < 1 || len(d.Targets) > 500 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	previous := ""
	for i, t := range d.Targets {
		id := hybridTargetIdentity(t)
		if !hybridTargetValid(t) || (i > 0 && id <= previous) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		previous = id
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(e)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > MaximumPlanningStateEventBytes {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func DecodePlanningStateChangedEvent(body []byte) (PlanningStateChangedEvent, error) {
	var e PlanningStateChangedEvent
	if len(body) == 0 || len(body) > MaximumPlanningStateEventBytes {
		return e, ErrValidation
	}
	env, err := strictDiagnosticObject(body, []string{"event_id", "event_type", "correlation_id", "causation_id", "student_id", "occurred_at", "schema_version", "data"})
	if err != nil {
		return e, err
	}
	data, err := strictDiagnosticObject(env["data"], []string{"learning_path_id", "path_version", "trigger_kind", "trigger_identity", "targets"})
	if err != nil {
		return e, err
	}
	var targets []json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(data["targets"], &targets) != nil || len(targets) < 1 || len(targets) > 500 {
		return e, ErrValidation
	}
	for _, raw := range targets {
		var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields) != nil {
			return e, ErrValidation
		}
		names := []string{"type", "key"}
		if _, ok := fields["version"]; ok {
			names = append(names, "version")
		}
		if _, err := strictDiagnosticObject(raw, names); err != nil {
			return e, err
		}
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(body, &e) != nil || ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(e) != nil {
		return PlanningStateChangedEvent{}, ErrValidation
	}
	var timestamp string
	if json.Unmarshal(env["occurred_at"], &timestamp) != nil || timestamp != e.OccurredAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano) {
		return PlanningStateChangedEvent{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return e, nil
}
